description: Deterministic repository feature map for Mizyun

features.title: Meal & Nutrition Logging
features.summary: Manual food CRUD, keyset-paginated history/search, macro/calorie calculations, local-day offsets, offline drafts, and photo/text draft generation.

relations.reason: Authenticated user context and RLS user_id filter
Food schema, nutrition breakdown contracts, and mutation types
Daily nutrition totals aggregate into energy balance and surplus/deficit
AI nutrition drafting and Coach nutrition advice access food entries

features.limitations: Reviewed against HEAD plus disclosed local pagination and meal-workflow changes. Live vision model photo drafting requires external provider evaluation per BEFORE_TESTING.md
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-007/Q2: Durable unknown-outcome persistence for ambiguous retries across network drops

features.title: Workouts & Sets Tracking
features.summary: Custom exercises, workout templates, active workout session recovery, and progressive overload calculations.

relations.reason: User authentication and RLS ownership on exercise/workout records
Training contracts, exercise enums, and set volume interfaces
Coach workout recommendations read completed volume and workout sets

features.limitations: Active workout recovery is local-first in mobile state; cloud sync occurs on set/workout completion

features.title: Profile, Goals & Energy Engine
features.summary: User onboarding profile, target goals, deterministic Mifflin-St Jeor TDEE/BMR calculations, surplus/deficit dashboard, and weight trends.

relations.reason: Profile creation tied to auth user lifecycle and JWT claims
Shared profile, goals, and energy contracts
Coach advice grounds on user profile limitations and energy targets

features.limitations: Body weight entries are retrieved from body_measurements; wearable live step integration is post-MVP

features.title: Body Measurements & Private Media
features.summary: Weight and circumference tracking, user-scoped private media uploads, EXIF-stripped progress photos, and timeline comparison.

relations.reason: Supabase Storage bucket policy requires matching auth.uid() folder prefix
Weight trends drive TDEE adaptation and surplus/deficit progress
Account deletion requires permanent deletion of user-scoped private media objects

features.limitations: Physical camera hardware capture tested manually; CI validates media uploads via synthetic fixtures
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-005: Non-diagnostic body photo policy evaluation with live provider

features.title: Authentication & Session Identity
features.summary: GoTrue user registration, confirmation tokens, native SecureStore session persistence, token refresh, and session gate state.

relations.reason: Supplies bearer token for authenticated API requests
Supplies bearer token for authenticated API requests
Identity sign-out and GoTrue account removal

features.limitations: Dev uses auto-confirmed email policy; Production requires real SES email confirmation
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-004: Native Google-login parity on iOS / own-account login

features.title: Account Lifecycle (Export & Deletion)
features.summary: GDPR-compliant full user data export (JSON/ZIP/share sheet), multi-stage tombstoned account deletion, status recovery, and cache clearance.

relations.reason: Requires authenticated caller identity and issues deletion challenge tokens
Purges Storage assets during account deletion Stage 2
Purges conversational history and memory items

features.limitations: Permanent deletion of external AI provider server logs is governed by Google Gemini 30-day abuse retention window
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-001/Q4: Worker lease renewal & storage resume barriers
REL-AUD-002/Q5: Vector memory & private media archive export

features.title: AI Coach, Consent & Token Budgets
features.summary: Conversational AI trainer, input safety screening, user consent continuation, token budget accounting, and memory lifecycle.

relations.reason: AI access requires authentication, adult eligibility, and current granted consent; email allowlisting is deprecated
Coach advice grounds on profile constraints, goals, and energy targets
Multimodal photo drafting shares Gemini provider and token quota

features.limitations: Reviewed against HEAD plus disclosed local changes. Gemini is the only active model provider; live evaluation remains gated by BEFORE_TESTING.md and the offline screener covers 56 heuristic cases
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-005/Q8: Live model benchmarking & reservation leases
REL-AUD-005/Q7: Consent UI context preservation across app restarts

features.title: In-App User Feedback
features.summary: User bug reports and suggestions with diagnostic client context, optional screenshot attachments, and unread admin status tracking.

relations.reason: Feedback records are owned by the authenticated caller

features.limitations: Feedback media attachments are capped at 5MB and stored in private user storage

features.title: Environment, Build Matrix & Deployment Safeguards
features.summary: Multi-profile EAS build matrix, environment schema validation, promotion scripts, deployment safeguards, systemd unit templates, and rollback.

relations.reason: Provides typed and validated environment variables to API and mobile composition roots

features.limitations: Reviewed against HEAD plus disclosed local changes. Dev and Production run on the Hetzner CX23 with role-specific identities and services; the Pi is encrypted recovery storage and local Qwen is paused
openAcceptance: REL-AUD-003/R3 Part B: Store distribution signing keys and release build profiles
INFRA-DUAL-005/R8: Physical-device standalone journey and off-device backup restore rehearsal

features.title: Shared Process Contracts
features.summary: Zod-validated versioned request, response, and domain entity schemas shared between server API and mobile client.

relations.reason: Provides typed schemas for meal mutation and nutrition payloads
Provides typed schemas for exercises and workout logs
Provides typed schemas for profile and energy payloads

features.limitations: Must never depend on frameworks, databases, or model vendors

features.title: PostgreSQL Migrations & RLS Policies
features.summary: Authoritative database migrations, Row Level Security policies, indexes, pgTAP tests, and database verification tooling.

relations.reason: Database cascade rules and tombstones govern deletion lifecycle
RLS rules govern food_entries table
RLS rules govern workouts and workout_sets tables

features.limitations: Destructive verification (pnpm db:verify) runs strictly on the local disposable Mac stack, never on Hetzner or the Pi recovery host

features.title: Application Composition Roots
features.summary: Server Fastify application initialization, route assembly, plugin registration, and mobile Expo Router application wiring.

relations.reason: Loads validated runtime configuration from packages/config
Mounts food entries API route plugin
Mounts workout API route plugin
Mounts coach API route plugin and selects active model provider

features.limitations: Composition roots must select concrete adapters without leaking vendor SDKs into domain layers

features.title: Privacy-First Analytics & Observability
features.summary: Local event telemetry, coarse activation/retention metrics, crash/error classification, and diagnostic logging without user PII.

relations.reason: Provides structured Pino logging to Fastify API and local event capture in mobile
Requires authenticated user session for ingestion and consent RPCs
Shared analytics event schemas and batch transport contracts

features.limitations: Server-side first-party analytics with 30-day retention and explicit opt-in consent

features.title: Legal, Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
features.summary: Public terms of service, GDPR privacy policies, store listing disclosures, and legal compliance endpoint routes.

relations.reason: Privacy policy governs data retention and deletion rights

features.limitations: Static legal markdown rendered publicly via API endpoints

features.title: Optional Health Platform Steps
features.summary: Opt-in, device-only daily step totals from iOS HealthKit and Android Health Connect.

relations.reason: Steps appear on the dashboard but do not change energy estimates
Local opt-in is scoped to the signed-in user

features.limitations: No backend sync or calorie adjustment; physical permission and step-count acceptance pending
openAcceptance: Physical iPhone and Android granted/denied/revoked checks
Public privacy policy and Google Play Health declarations before release
ACT-02–04 source provenance and idempotent persisted sync remain future scope

features.title: System Health & Diagnostics
features.summary: Public health check endpoints (/v1/health) used by uptime monitors, deployment scripts, and rollback triggers.

relations.reason: Health check endpoint queried during deployment verification and rollback evaluation

features.limitations: Returns service name, timestamp, and ok status; does not exercise database transaction isolation

features.title: Community & Friend Workout Sharing
features.summary: Opt-in friends, comments, private groups, cooperative challenges, mutual messages, quarantined photos, deliberate routine snapshots and bounded consent-based discovery on Dev.

relations.reason: Authenticated user context and adult age eligibility verification
Workout completion source for published snapshot creation

features.limitations: Dev-only client enrollment requires exact Dev targets; server cohort is authoritative. Founder Dev testing activation is explicitly authorized for a confirmed account; broader participant/Dev/device/provider/operator/legal/restore/pilot acceptance remains pending.
openAcceptance: COMM-01 genuine adult target-user validation including voluntary decliner; design/source complete
COMM-03 physical enrollment/settings/withdrawal and contact/legal/moderation/retention/admission gates
COMM-04 physical relationship/graph/block/mute/account-switch acceptance and reporting/delivery/retention dependencies
COMM-05 installed cold/warm/login/QR/environment/account-switch and not-installed fallback acceptance
COMM-06 physical preview/publish/edit/unpublish/source-delete acceptance and feed/delivery dependencies
COMM-07–16 feed, moderation, inbox/delivery, lifecycle/export/restore, rollout and exact-candidate pilot gates
COMM-17–23 expansion real Auth/Storage, device, moderation, lifecycle, restore and Dev acceptance on the exact final candidate

features.title: Shared agent navigation and impact
features.summary: Automatically refresh local source/config discovery, bounded task context and advisory source impact across coding agents.
features.limitations: Reviewed HEAD plus disclosed local tooling changes. Static relationships are advisory; automatic refresh is not semantic review or release acceptance.
openAcceptance: GitHub #54: fresh Codex and Antigravity sessions must demonstrate shared skill discovery and behavior; no installed-client or token-saving measurement is inferred from CLI fixtures.
